$comment: The AndroidX Wear samples pin for :samples-catalog. See docs/design/ANDROIDX_SAMPLES.md. `ref` is a COMMIT SHA and never a branch, so a render is reproducible and an upstream bump is a reviewable diff. Unlike the phone repo there is NO version-derivation problem here: `:catalog` compiles against the real androidx.wear.compose artifact, so the pin is simply the commit matching the version in gradle/libs.versions.toml -- resolved by date from that artifact's POM Last-Modified, because the androidx GitHub mirror publishes no tags. Bumping `wear-compose` means re-resolving this ref in the same PR. `resourcePaths` carries the drawables the samples resolve `R.drawable.*` against -- meaningful here because this is an ANDROID module, unlike the phone catalog which renders through CMP desktop where no `R` class exists. `paths` is fetched with a blobless sparse clone (13 MB, not the multi-GB tree).
refDescription: androidx-main as of 2026-09-09, the last main commit before the first 1.8.0-only sample change (aa6c45adf9, StatusBarSuppression). androidx.wear.compose:compose-material3 1.7.1 was published 2026-10-07 from a release branch the GitHub mirror does not carry, so main on that date is already on the 1.8 API (curveToEdge, PullToRefreshBox, the new Slider overloads) and does not compile against it.
